entities.name: Roenis Elías
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Roenis Leliebre Elías is a Cuban professional baseball pitcher for the Tecolotes de los Dos Laredos of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Boston Red Sox, Washington Nationals, and Seattle Mariners, and in the KBO League for the SSG Landers and in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) for the Fubon Guardians.
